title: Asset Pricing on Earnings Announcement Days
about: Examines aggregate earnings-release timing and the cross-sectional pricing of beta.
findings: Authors associate early earnings announcement days with a stronger beta-return relation. Not independently reproduced and not an unconditional intraday ES result.
mechanism: Aggregate earnings information and risk pricing are proposed explanations.
